Instead, we simmer a generous amount of vegetables, chicken, pork bones, niboshi (dried ... Read more sardines), and katsuobushi (dried bonito flakes) for a full two days to concentrate the flavors of the ingredients. The result is a rich, nutritious, additive-free soup base. Just take a spoonful of the soup, and you'll experience a perfect blend of umami, sweetness, acidity, and spices that will surely bring a smile to your face. You'll definitely think, "Samurai's soup curry is delicious!!"
